items.difficulty_reason: The counted conclusion is that the derived limit object K of the pseudo-coherent descent situation lies in D^- with quasi-coherent cohomology, at source lines 2694-2702, label lemma-compute-what-it-should-be-derived, whose proof occupies source lines 2704-2750. None of the load bearing steps is a citation: the proof first converts the displayed formula for K into a boundedness question using that the coherator DQ_X is a right adjoint commuting with derived limits and has bounded cohomological dimension, then on affine etale opens combines the Milnor exact sequence for R lim with the affine comparison for complexes with quasi-coherent cohomology sheaves to reduce the question to a uniform bound on the top degrees a_n, and finally proves a_{n-1} = a_n for all n by pseudo-coherence and Nakayama over the thickenings of the system, the parenthetical stalk argument at source line 2747-2748. The counted statement records none of this machinery: neither of the two reductions nor the Nakayama locking of the top degrees appears in it.
